acceptance_criteria.description: Every configured command hook has a Windows PowerShell commandWindows wrapper; hook JSON validation rejects missing or non-PowerShell Windows wrappers.
A source-changing tool call during a debugging task is denied until a minimal reproduction command successfully reproduces the reported failure and exact trace, with structured evidence.
After valid reproduction evidence is recorded, the source-edit gate permits the scoped fix; missing, stale, mismatched, or non-reproducing evidence remains denied with corrective guidance.
Repository guidance mandates hypothesis formation, executable minimal reproduction, baseline confirmation, one causal change at a time, and rerunning reproduction plus focused regression checks.
No unsupported defaultShell settings key is introduced; docs explain the supported Codex commandWindows mechanism and any user-level settings boundary.
